messages:
jordan: Quick sync — following up on the RCA from 2026-03-10. We have 5 cross-team action items that need explicit owners + due dates so we can close the postmortem. Reply with "I'm on it - due YYYY-MM-DD" or assign someone. I'll keep the RCA doc updated.

```
A1) Add model-routing fallback policy for capacity overloads (eng-platform) — owner: _?_, due: _?_
A2) Increase KV cache retention for chat sessions (eng-ml + infra) — owner: _?_, due: _?_
A3) Add high-tail-latency alert + runbook (eng-sre) — owner: _?_, due: _?_
A4) Rollback steps + runbook update for serving runtime (eng-oncall) — owner: _?_, due: _?_
A5) Confirm data retention & export controls for Private deploys (security) — owner: _?_, due: _?_
```

jordan: Plan: close items by end of sprint unless blockers called out. If blocked, add `block:` tag and short note. :eyes:

sarah: I'm on A3 - due 2026-03-18. I'll add alert rules to PagerDuty + a short runbook, will link here when done. :+1:

min: A2 sounds like my lane but I need infra changes for larger cache size. Can own A2 but need @praveen for infra apply. Target 2026-03-22. I have a draft PR: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/436 (WIP)

praveen: assigning infra work for A2 to myself (will coordinate with @min). I'll schedule the infra change and aim for 2026-03-22. If quota needs bump I'll flag asap.

tay: I'll take A1 (eng-platform). Proposed due 2026-03-20. Plan: add policy + canary route and a fail-open toggle. I'll open INF ticket and link.

lena-security: A5 - security will validate retention/export controls and produce approval doc. Owning this, due 2026-03-24. I'll add checklist items to the RCA doc.

jordan: Great — can folks paste the ticket/PR links when created so I can mark progress? Also confirm if any of these need Exec notif.

praveen: INF-7892 created for A2 infra changes: https://infra.track/INF-7892 — assigning to praveen + min, due 2026-03-22.

devops-bot: Created ticket INF-7901 for A1 assigned to tay. (link: https://infra.track/INF-7901)

jordan: Thanks — tagging closure plan: once PRs merged + infra applied + runbook links posted, I'll mark the RCA actions closed. If anyone expects >1 week slip please call it out now.

sarah: If anyone needs help with the runbook steps I can pair.

min: will ping if we hit quota or kernel rollout conflicts. otherwise 2026-03-22 should be fine.

jordan: OK closing the loop here — I'll update the RCA doc and send a short summary to the stakeholders. Appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:
